sign: Every post holds a candle for someone who walked off the edge. Keep to the light. The light is not keen on company.
lamplighter: Agnes: I light the posts at dusk. One of them is new every week. I don't ask. The Choir sends the name.
lamplighter_intro: Agnes: There's a fresh post at the end with no name yet. Let's see if it's yours.
lamplighter_defeat: Agnes: Not yours. Not today. I'll keep it dry.
